name: St Michael Cornhill

name: St Peter Cornhill

name: St Vedast
rationale: Listing short name for St Vedast Foster Lane; page location is Foster Lane.

name: St Alban Wood Street
rationale: Same site as seed entry St Alban's, Wood Street (tower only survives).

name: Christchurch Newgate otherwise known as Christchurch Greyfriars
rationale: Listing title names Christchurch Greyfriars explicitly.

rationale: St Augustine Watling Street was united with St Faith under St Paul's; tower-only listing is the same site.

name: St Swithun London Stone

name: St Peter Cheap

name: St Olave Silver Street
rationale: Same lost parish as St Olave's, Silver Street in the not-rebuilt list; garden on the former site.
